content: I assume you're referring to the *Prototipo RS - Red/Black/Orange* shoes. These shoes provide all-day comfort and versatility, featuring additional comfort padding on the tongue, heel, and collar. They also have an ONSTEAM anti-microbial lining for moisture and odor control, along with a removable, contoured cork and EVA foam insole with a perforated footbed.
